moves.label: Lion Combo Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a short active window that opens Sasuke's close pressure.
moves.reason: Short standing taijutsu strike fits the existing Lion Combo base.

moves.label: Windmill Blade Sweep
moves.description: Fast high blade sweep with a steady active arc and balanced recovery.
moves.reason: The crescent blade arc rides high across the upper body line.

moves.label: Chidori Thrust
moves.description: Quick mid lightning-style thrust with a brief active hit and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Forward body thrust matches the Chidori label and mid contact height.

moves.label: Grand Fireball Wheel
moves.description: Fast high jumping fire-wheel slash with long active travel and strong tracking.
moves.reason: Flip sequence with bright arc effect supports Fire Release flavor, jump, and strong tracking.

moves.label: Sharingan Blade Rush
moves.description: Slow mid blade rush with a long active string and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Multi-pose sword rush stays at body height without a special property.

moves.label: Rising Lion Launcher
moves.description: Quick high launcher with a long active rising arc that pops opponents up.
moves.reason: Rising arc and authored launch height support launcher naming.

moves.label: Aerial Chidori Thrust
moves.description: Steady high jumping thrust with a tiny active hit and strong tracking.
moves.reason: Horizontal airborne dash reads as a jumping thrust.

moves.label: Low Sharingan Feint
moves.description: Slow low feint with a modest active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: The stance dips low before returning upright, matching low feint data.

moves.label: Low Flame Wheel
moves.description: Quick low jumping knockdown with long active travel and high commitment.
moves.reason: Low-starting flip attack is authored as knockdown and visually leaves the ground.

moves.label: Aerial Lion Drop
moves.description: Slow high jumping drop that leaves Sasuke crouched after a long active descent.
moves.reason: Airborne descent settles into a crouched finish.

moves.label: Crouch Chidori Dash
moves.description: Fast high crouch dash with long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch entry drives forward through a high rushing strike.

moves.label: Crouch Chidori Launcher
moves.description: Quick mid crouch launcher with a brief active thrust and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-thrust motion uses the same launcher-valued Chidori body shape.

moves.label: Crouch Windmill Blade
moves.description: Fast high crouch blade check with a steady active arc and balanced recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch command reuses the high windmill blade arc.

moves.label: Crouch Fireball Wheel
moves.description: Fast high crouch-entry fire wheel with long active jump pressure.
moves.reason: Crouch command transitions into the same Fire Release flip sequence.

moves.label: Fire Release Flip Kick
moves.description: Fast mid jumping flip kick with long active travel and strong tracking.
moves.reason: Shorter Fire Release variant hits mid while airborne.

moves.label: Overdrive Low Cutter
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown cutter that ends in full crouch after a tiny active hit.
moves.reason: Overdrive slash drops low, carries knockdown, and finishes crouched.

moves.label: Overdrive Fire Tornado
moves.description: Fast high jumping fire wheel that works as a tornado extender.
moves.reason: Airborne spinning fire-wheel frames justify tornado and jump properties.

moves.label: Sidestep Windmill Blade
moves.description: Fast high sidestep blade sweep with a steady active arc and balanced recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep variant uses the high windmill blade frames.

moves.label: Sidestep Chidori Lunge
moves.description: Steady mid sidestep lunge with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Side-entry horizontal lunge appears airborne and tracks strongly.

moves.label: Rising Chidori Check
moves.description: Quick mid while-rising thrust with a brief active hit and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: While-standing sequence uses the Chidori thrust silhouette.

moves.label: Rising Fire Launcher
moves.description: Fast high jumping launcher with long active fire-wheel pressure.
moves.reason: Rising input enters the airborne fire-wheel sequence with authored launch height.

moves.label: Ducking Lion Jab
moves.description: Fast high ducking jab with a short active window and clean recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the quick high Lion Combo strike.

moves.label: Ducking Windmill Blade
moves.description: Fast high ducking blade sweep with a steady active arc.
moves.reason: Down kick uses the same upper-body windmill blade arc.

moves.label: Phoenix Sage Slash
moves.description: Quick mid Fire Release slash with a tiny active cut and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Existing Phoenix Sage label fits the short fire-styled sword cut.

moves.label: Diagonal Chidori Check
moves.description: Quick mid diagonal thrust with a brief active hit and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Down-forward input uses the same mid Chidori thrust frames.

moves.label: Diagonal Windmill Blade
moves.description: Fast high diagonal blade sweep with a steady active arc and balanced recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward kick variant shares the high windmill blade animation.

moves.label: Forward Lion Jab
moves.description: Fast high forward jab with a short active window and clean recovery.
moves.reason: Forward jab is the same quick high taijutsu poke.

moves.label: Forward Chidori Cut
moves.description: Steady mid forward cut with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward heavy has a compact mid thrust/cut and weak-right tracking.

moves.label: Advancing Windmill Blade
moves.description: Fast high advancing blade sweep with a steady active arc.
moves.reason: Forward kick uses the same windmill blade arc at high level.

moves.label: Sharingan Quick Jab
moves.description: Fast high quarter-circle jab with a short active window and clean recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab repeats the quick high strike.

moves.label: Chidori Rising Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid jumping launcher with a brief active pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Rising airborne lunge has authored launch height and jump property.

moves.label: Fire Tornado Wheel
moves.description: Fast high jumping fire wheel that works as a tornado extender with strong tracking.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle version uses airborne spinning fire-wheel frames with tornado data.
